# Waste//Freight

> Training for the people who ship hazardous waste: combined RCRA/DOT hazmat training, hazardous waste manifests, generator training and universal waste shipping.

Waste//Freight (https://waste-shipping.hazwoperosha.us/) sells online training from HAZWOPER OSHA Training, LLC (https://hazwoper-osha.com/). Courses are 100% online and self-paced, and each includes a certificate of completion. Prices are per seat; seats for a whole crew can be bought in one checkout. Phone +1-866-429-6742, email info@hazwoper-osha.com.

## When to use this site

- Use it when someone needs RCRA/DOT Combined, Manifest, Generator Training, Generator Refresher or related training, wants to compare those courses, or needs to know what a regulation requires them to take.
- Each course page lists the length, the price per seat, the regulation it covers, what it teaches and who it's for.
- To enroll, open a course's enroll link below. It opens the checkout on that page; payment is by card through Stripe. For an invoice or purchase order, call +1-866-429-6742 or email info@hazwoper-osha.com.
- Every page is also served as Markdown: send `Accept: text/markdown`, or add `.md` to the path (https://waste-shipping.hazwoperosha.us/index.md).

## Courses

- [EPA RCRA/DOT Combined Hazardous Materials Compliance Training](https://waste-shipping.hazwoperosha.us/courses/epa-rcra-dot-combined-hazardous-materials-compliance-training): $149.99 per seat, 8 Hours, RCRA + 49 CFR 172. One course covering RCRA generator rules and DOT hazmat employee training for waste shippers. Enroll: https://waste-shipping.hazwoperosha.us/courses/epa-rcra-dot-combined-hazardous-materials-compliance-training?buy=403
- [Hazardous Waste Manifest Training](https://waste-shipping.hazwoperosha.us/courses/hazardous-waste-manifest-training): $58.99 per seat, 2 Hours, 40 CFR 262 Subpart B (RCRA). The Uniform Hazardous Waste Manifest and e-Manifest, box by box. Enroll: https://waste-shipping.hazwoperosha.us/courses/hazardous-waste-manifest-training?buy=580
- [RCRA Hazardous Waste Generator Training](https://waste-shipping.hazwoperosha.us/courses/rcra-hazardous-waste-generator-training): $134.99 per seat, 8 Hours, 40 CFR 262.17 (RCRA). RCRA generator training: from waste determination to shipment. Enroll: https://waste-shipping.hazwoperosha.us/courses/rcra-hazardous-waste-generator-training?buy=601
- [RCRA Hazardous Waste Generator Refresher Training](https://waste-shipping.hazwoperosha.us/courses/rcra-hazardous-waste-generator-refresher-training): $124.99 per seat, 4 Hours, 40 CFR 262.17 (RCRA, annual). Annual RCRA refresher. Enroll: https://waste-shipping.hazwoperosha.us/courses/rcra-hazardous-waste-generator-refresher-training?buy=600
- [RCRA Universal Waste Handler Training](https://waste-shipping.hazwoperosha.us/courses/rcra-universal-waste-handler-training): $34.99 per seat, 2 Hours, 40 CFR 273 (RCRA). Managing and shipping universal waste under 40 CFR 273. Enroll: https://waste-shipping.hazwoperosha.us/courses/rcra-universal-waste-handler-training?buy=602

## Guides

- [DOT hazmat training for hazardous waste shippers](https://waste-shipping.hazwoperosha.us/guides/dot-hazmat-training-for-waste-shippers): If you sign the manifest, you're a DOT hazmat employee. What 49 CFR 172.704 requires.
- [Preparing a hazardous waste shipment, step by step](https://waste-shipping.hazwoperosha.us/guides/preparing-a-hazardous-waste-shipment): From the drum to the truck: the pre-transport checklist generators should follow.
- [Land disposal restriction notices, explained](https://waste-shipping.hazwoperosha.us/guides/land-disposal-restriction-notices): The LDR notice is one of the most overlooked shipping documents. What it is and when you need one.
